term: International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling
definition: The International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS) is a leading international academic conference in automated planning and scheduling held annually for researchers and practitioners in planning and scheduling.
details: ICAPS is supported by the National Science Foundation, the journal Artificial Intelligence, and other supporters.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling.
